title: UI风格#122 - Botanical Illustration (植物科学插画)
description: 创建第122种UI风格：植物科学插画风格 - 植物学绘画、细腻线条、古籍质感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDR.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When color palette Then features aged paper, botanical green, terracotta, sepia tones
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#F5F5DC (古纸), #228B22 (植物绿), #E07B39 (赤陶), #8B4513 (赭色), #D2B48C (淡褐)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When typography Then uses scientific fonts: EB Garamond, Lora, or Spectral
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：EB Garamond (标题), Lora (正文), Spectral (标签)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When layout Then specimen plates, label annotations, aged paper texture, margin notes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：标本图版、标签注解、古纸质感、边注

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration style When UI elements Then watercolor washes, fine line drawings, aged stains
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：水彩晕染、细线绘制、陈年污渍、纸张泛黄

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration UI When functional Then includes herbarium chat, botanist agents, specimen stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：植物标本聊天、植物学家代理、标本统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Botanical Illustration UI When copy Then uses botanical latin: 'Specimen', 'Genus', 'Species', 'Herbarium'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'SPECIMEN. GENUS. SPECIES.'、按钮'SEND'→'CATALOG'、'SUBMIT'→'PRESERVE'
